summary: Morgan Stanley Capital I Trust 2017-H1 filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 announcing that, effective September 1, 2026, C-IV Asset Management LLC will act as special servicer for the 123 William Street mortgage loan under the WFCM 2017-RB1 pooling and servicing agreement, following Greystone Servicing Company LLC's sale of its special servicing division to C-IV AM. This is a routine servicing transfer notification for an ABS trust, not a special situation transaction. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions are involved. The filing merely updates investors on servicer succession; no special-situation angle exists.
